entities.name: Rise of Polotsk Principality
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Polotsk emerged as a powerful principality under Rogvolod and later Vseslav the Sorcerer (r. 1044–1101), competing with Kyiv for regional dominance. The Saint Sophia Cathedral in Polotsk was built in the mid-11th century.
